title: Quarto Listings
text: A Quarto listing creates a collection from the metadata in other .qmd files. For a portfolio, this means I can add a new project file and Quarto will automatically add it to the page with the same card layout, sorting, filtering, and categories.

title: Using CSS & SCSS with Quarto
text: Quarto websites use Bootstrap as a starting point. I used SCSS for site-wide choices such as colors and fonts, and CSS for specific page elements such as the home-page layout and skill cards.

title: Website Design Notes
text:
Organization
The navigation connects the four required pages. The listing page is generated from the files in the projects folder, so it can grow without rebuilding the layout by hand.

title: Website Design Notes
text:
Publishing
Quarto renders the website to _site. The source files can be stored on GitHub and the rendered website can be published with quarto publish gh-pages.
